subject: Deployment of 2 Seasonal Vessel Tracking devices - Halifax Harbour and Approaches
text:
Deployment of 2 Seasonal Vessel Tracking devices - Halifax Harbour and Approaches
Deployment of two seasonal vessel tracking devices in 44 39.495N 063 33.666W and 44 39.363N 063 33.501W connected with a communications cable to the South finger pier of COVE in Dartmouth. Maximum height of array off of the seafloor is 3 metres. Caution.
